changes: Letters of rare alphabets, hieroglyphs, ancient scripts and fancy math letters now show in every app instead of empty boxes.
Newer emoji no longer show as empty boxes in apps.
Certificates now update on every phone, also on one that has never had a certificate imported.
Expired root certificates are found on the phone itself.
New emoji in every app: Telegram or Noto style, or a font file of your own.
Light or dark theme, for the Hub and for the rest of the system.
